messages.author: 23ada2860df4d7fa
messages.subject: spatio-temporal with STAN
parts:
Hi
I want to fit a spatio-temporal model with STAN, but I don't know anything about STAN. I want to know can I use whatever priors that I like?
Thanks in advance

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] spatio-temporal with STAN
parts:
Welcome to Stan. Yes, use whatever prior you'd like. We aren't limited to conjugacy here.

The only catch is that we don't have discrete parameters. Discrete data is fine. This isn't usually a problem because on most cases you can marginalize out the discrete parameter and estimate a continuous one instead. (Details in the manual.)

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] spatio-temporal with STAN
parts:
Check out the manual chapter on latent discrete parameters.
But if it's just a single parameter, then yes, it's easy.
It's also easy if it's multiple discrete parameters if each
is associated with a subset of data item(s).

- Bob
